name: @pipeworx/mcp-ebi-ols

tools.name: list_ontologies
tools.description: EMBL-EBI Ontology Lookup Service (OLS4) — page through every biomedical ontology loaded into OLS, such as GO, EFO, MONDO, ChEBI, HPO and UBERON. Returns each ontology's id, title, description, term count, version and status, with size/page controls. Answers which biomedical ontologies are searchable here and what the short id for one is.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all ontologies (or one).

tools.name: get_term
tools.description: Term details. Pass either iri, short_form, or obo_id (the latter two require ontology).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ebi-ols forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ebi-ols pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
